newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Liton '96 pretax profit up 30 pct.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Liton '96 pretax profit up 30 pct.

text.p: Taiwan's Liton Electronic said on Tuesday it made a pretax profit of T$1.087 billion in 1996, up from T$836 million in 1995.
Its 1996 sales reached T$10.561 billion, up from T$9.126 billion in 1995, the firm said in a statement.
Liton's board meeting proposed a dividend of T$2.5 per share for 1997, including T$0.5/share in cash dividend and T$2/share in stock dividend, or bonus issue, it said.
It plans to issue T$400 million in overseas convertible bonds to raise funds for operations, but gave no issue date.
All the proposals need final shareholder approval at a meeting slated for May 16, it said.
